sections.text_helper: Section 48.5 "SAES interrupts" in chapter 48 (Secure AES coprocessor (SAES)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2340.
sections.section_content:
There are multiple individual maskable interrupt sources generated by the SAES peripheral
to signal the following events:
• computation completed (CCF)
• read error (RDERRF)
• write error (WRERRF)
• key error (KEIF)
• RNG error (RNGEIF)
See Section48.4.19: SAES error management for details on SAES errors.
These sources are combined into a common interrupt signal from the SAES peripheral that
connects to the Cortex® CPU interrupt controller. Application can enable or disable SAES
interrupt sources individually by setting/clearing the corresponding enable bit of the
SAES_IER register.
The status of the individual maskable interrupt sources can be read from the SAES_ISR
register. They are cleared by setting the corresponding bit of the SAES_ICR register.
Table411 gives a summary of the available features.
